# Upstream 922a9f046c4a2714edf2b76fec3d1862dcd56ae3:
# command.py:1257-1264 supports detached submission; 5957 jobs_launch submits,
# 6345 jobs_queue inspects. Go run is detached by default, with explicit --wait.
# Durable retry keys are a Go extension, not an upstream compatibility claim.
taskfile success.json success
taskfile failure.json failure
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id successful --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
stdout '"target": *"local"'
stderr '^request-id: successful\njob: '
! stdout 'request-id:'
job-id SUCCESS
skygo jobs get $SUCCESS
stdout '^ID: "'$SUCCESS'"\n'
stdout '^Target: "local"$'
stdout '^State: succeeded$'
! stdout '\x1b'
! stderr .
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id successful --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$SUCCESS'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'

# Upstream command.py:2824-2837 distinguishes terminal outcomes with nonzero
# codes. Go uses exit 2 for any unsuccessful waited job, not 100/103.
! skygo --json run -f failure.json --request-id failed --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_FAILED"'
stdout '"exit_code": *7'
job-id FAILURE
env SKYGO_EXIT_CODE
stdout '^SKYGO_EXIT_CODE=2\n$'
skygo --json jobs get $FAILURE
stdout '"id": *"'$FAILURE'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_FAILED"'
skygo jobs list
stdout '^ID +TARGET +STATE\n'
stdout $SUCCESS' +local +succeeded'
stdout $FAILURE' +local +failed'
! stdout '\x1b'
! stderr .
